description: This PHP source file defines a class 'ViewAjaxUI' that extends the 'SugarView' class, providing a specific view for AJAX UI components in the SuiteCRM project. It contains a constructor to set display options and a method to send HTTP cache headers and modify global state during rendering.

classes.name: ViewAjaxUI
classes.description: A specialized view class tailored for AJAX UI content within SuiteCRM, extending the base SugarView class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the view with specific display options such as showing title, header, footer, JavaScript, and hiding subpanels and search.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates an ETag header for caching based on the current user and modifies a global flag to prevent double-footers.
